summary: daemon.js: split decideAction() into decideOne(L,ctx) (per-loop decision honoring L's own budget/iterations/config/session, mutates L) + decideAll() which iterates every ACTIVE loop and returns batched array [{loopId,action,tasks?,next_poll_seconds,...}]. `batch` now multiplexes ACROSS loops via shared per-tick spawn pool ctx.batch.remaining (= max active loop batch); each spawning loop draws from it and sets L.lastProgress=now() (progress signal for task 3). applyOptimize now takes the loop entry L (uses L.config/L.active, no per-call save). /next-action route still calls old decideAction — rewired in task 4.
